metadata.purpose: Document enforcement of E2E data flow specification

content.enforcementSummary: Completed E2E data flow by implementing missing dashboard problem query endpoint. All 4 gaps (CLI registration, session linking, SurrealDB persistence, project API) were already deployed. Added GET /auth/orgs/{org_id}/projects/{project_id}/problems endpoint to enable dashboard to retrieve and display problems grouped by component with temporal statistics.

changesApplied.reason: Complete E2E data flow from metabob-cli to dashboard. Enables dashboard to query problems by project_id with JWT authentication and org_id hierarchy verification. Provides grouped_by_component and severity_distribution statistics for dashboard display.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - new endpoint only, no modifications to existing code. Integrates with existing problem_ops.list_problems_by_project() and project_ops.get_project(). Protected by JWT auth (get_current_user) and org_id verification. Returns problems with temporal ordering (ORDER BY created_at DESC) and pagination support.

metabobAnnotation.reason: Completes metabob-cli-to-dashboard-e2e-data-flow specification by providing dashboard access to problems stored in SurrealDB with org/project hierarchy and temporal tracking

dataFlowCompletion.before: CLI → RPC API → SurrealDB → ??? (dashboard endpoint missing)

responseSchema.problems: List[Dict] - problems with full schema from SurrealDB
responseSchema.grouped_by_component: Dict[str, int] - problems grouped by file_path
responseSchema.severity_distribution: Dict[str, int] - problems grouped by severity

validationChecklistUpdate.V5: READY - Temporal tracking (uses ORDER BY created_at DESC)

criticalGapsResolved.resolution: Implemented GET /auth/orgs/{org_id}/projects/{project_id}/problems endpoint with full schema compliance, JWT authentication, org_id verification, pagination, severity filtering, and statistics calculation (grouped_by_component, severity_distribution)
